hook: Medicine (医) + institution (院): the small doctor's building near your home, a clinic.
As before (依) + as it is (然): nothing has changed, still, as yet.
One (一) belt (帯) of land: the whole area around a place.
A different (異) move (動): being moved to another post at work, a transfer.
Clothes (衣) + materials (料): clothing and the cloth to make it.
織 has thread (糸) on the left: you weave threads into cloth.
欠 means missing (as in 欠席, absence): to lack something, or to chip off a piece.
Study (学) + history (歴): your history of schools, your academic background.
Add (加) taste (味): adding flavour, seasoning.
Publish (刊) + go out (行): sending a book or magazine out, publication.
Used to (慣, as in 慣れる) + doing (行): something people are used to doing, a custom.
Government official (官) + colleague (僚): officials working together to run the state, bureaucrats.
Tool (器) + official job (官): a body part with its own job, an organ.
Season (季) + publish (刊): published once a season, quarterly.
Rise (起) + source (源): where something rises from, its origin.
Machine (機) + structure (構): how the parts are built together, a mechanism or organisation.
Rule (規) + control (制): controlling things with rules, regulation.
Hill (丘) + mound (陵): hills and more hills, hilly land.
Together (協) + discuss (議): sitting down together to talk it over, a conference.
Together (協) + tune (調): playing in tune together, cooperation and harmony.
Near (近) + sight (視): you only see near things clearly, nearsighted.
Measure (計) + tool (器): a tool for measuring, a meter or gauge.
Shape (形) + condition (態): the shape and state of something, its form.
Blood (血) + pipe (管): the pipes that carry blood, blood vessels.
Decide (決) + carry out (行): you decided, so now you do it, even in the rain.
Decrease (減) + few (少): it gets smaller and fewer, a decline.
Sail (航) + sea (海): sailing across the sea, a voyage.
Seize (拘) + tie in a bundle (束): grabbed and tied up, restrained.
Wild (荒) + abandoned (廃): left to go wild and fall apart, ruin.
Come down (降) + lie face down (伏): you get down on the ground and give up, surrender.
Rise up (興) + stirred up (奮): your feelings rise and burst out, excitement.
Word (語) + phrase (句): words and phrases.
Individual (個) repeated (々): each one, one by one.
Small (小) + coin money (銭): small change, coins.
Pick (採) + gather (集): picking things and collecting them, like bugs or plants.
Cut off (絶) + destroy (滅): completely wiped out, extinct.
Wash (洗) + chemical agent (剤): the stuff you wash with, detergent.
Whole (全) + body (身): the whole body, head to toe.
Forward (前) + advance (進): moving forward, progress.
Each other (相) + continue (続): passing things on from one generation to the next, inheritance.
Mutually (相) + match (当): it matches in value, worth; so also 'quite a lot'.
注 has the water mark (氵): to pour liquid into something, like rain into a river.
育 is the kanji of 教育 (education): a child being raised, to grow up.
Buckwheat (蕎) + wheat or grain (麦): noodles made from buckwheat, soba.
Coarse (粗) + end bits (末): rough leftover bits, poor and humble.
揃 has a hand (扌) and front (前): with your hand, line things up neatly in front.
Respect (尊) + heavy, important (重): treating someone as important, respect.
Big (大) + air (気): the big air around the Earth, the atmosphere.
Facing (対) + shine on (照): put two things face to face in the light to compare.
Big (大) + war (戦): a great war, like a world war.
Big (大) + half (半): the bigger half, most of it.
Big (大) + part (部分): the biggest part, the majority.
Topic (題) + name (名): the name you give a topic, a title.
平 means flat or calm, as in 平和 (peace): flat and level.
Big (大) + land (陸): a huge piece of land, a continent.
Tata, tata: the sound when you beat a drum. 叩 has a mouth (口) for the noise.
直 means straight, direct: go straight to it, at once.
畳 is a tatami mat: you fold (畳む) your futon on the tatami.
経 means pass through, as in 経験 (experience): time passes.
Foot (足) + bag (袋): a little bag for your foot, tabi socks.
偶 means chance, as in 偶然: by chance, it just happened.
便 means mail, as in 郵便: news that comes by mail, a letter.
頼 is also in 頼む (to ask a favour): you ask because you rely on them.
Man (男) + child (子): a boy or young man.
Know (知) + blessing (恵): knowledge given as a gift, wisdom.
Manage (知) + affairs (事): the person who manages a prefecture's affairs, the governor.
Ground (地) + flat (平) + line (線): the flat line where the ground ends, the horizon.
Middle (中) + old (古): half old, used, second-hand.
Noon (昼) + eat (食): the noon meal, lunch.
Pour (注) + eye (目): pour your eyes onto something, pay attention.
Write (著) + person (者): the person who wrote it, the author.
遂 means achieve, as in 遂げる: it is done at last, finally.
Go through (通) + pass (過): passing through a place without stopping.
Go around (通) + money (貨): money that goes around a country, currency.
Commute (通) + school (学): going to school every day.
注 has the water mark (氵): to pour a drink into a cup (つぐ is the everyday reading).
積 has grain (禾): pile up the harvested grain, to stack.
Go out (出) + meet (合): you go out and meet someone, an encounter.
Resist (抵) + oppose (抗): pushing back against something, resistance.
Suitable (適) + degree (度): just the right amount, moderate.
Suitable (適) + use (用): using a rule where it fits, applying it.
Hand (手) + item (品): tricks done with your hands and objects, magic.
Go through (徹) + bottom (底): going right through to the bottom, thoroughness.
Heaven (天) + as it is (然): as heaven made it, natural.
Copper (銅) + money (貨): a copper coin.
Move (動) + word (詞): an action word, a verb.
Way (道) + virtue (徳): the right way to live, morals.
East (東) + ocean (洋): the lands of the East, the Orient.
Child (童) + song (謡): a children's song.
通 means go through: you let someone go through, to let pass.
解 means untie or understand, as in 理解: undo a knot, solve a problem.
Special (特) + sign (徴): the special signs of something, its features.
Special (特) + strong point (長): a special strong point, a merit.
Alone (独) + special (特): special to just one thing, unique.
Alone (独) + stand (立): standing on your own, independence.
Inside (中) + taste (味): what is inside, the contents or filling.
殴 has the striking part (殳) on the right: to hit or punch.
無 means nothing or none, as in 無理: without.
怠 has a heart (心) at the bottom: a lazy heart, to slack off.
煮 has fire dots (灬) at the bottom: cook in water over fire, to boil.
Hot (熱) + belt (帯): the hot belt around the Earth, the tropics.
Heat (熱) + inside (中): burning hot inside about something, crazy about it.
Year (年) + generation (代): a span of years, an era like the 1980s.
載 means load, as in 記載 (record): load something on top, or put it in print.
望 means hope, as in 希望: a wish or hope.
望 means hope and gaze far, as in 望遠鏡 (telescope): to wish for, to view.
伸 has a person (亻): a person stretching out, to extend.
計 means measure, count, as in 時計 (clock): to measure time or amounts.
測 has water (氵): measure how deep the water is, length or size.
掃 has a hand (扌) and a broom (帚): sweep with a broom.
Nothing (莫) is bigger (大): so big nothing compares, enormous.
Burst (爆) + shoot out (発): it bursts out, an explosion.
Break (破) + property (産): your property is broken, bankruptcy.
Depart (発) + car (車): the train or bus departs.
Fire off (発) + shoot (射): shooting off a rocket or gun.
Start (発) + reach (達): growing until it reaches a higher level, development.
Bring out (発) + bright (明): bringing a bright idea out, an invention.
Spreading (派) hands (手): arms thrown wide for attention, showy and flashy.
Talk (話す) + together (合う): talk with each other, discuss.
離 means separate, as in 距離 (distance): to move apart.
Feather (羽) + root (根): a feather with its base, a feather.
省 means cut down, as in 省略 (omission): to leave out.
Against (反) + oppose (抗): fighting back against someone, rebellion.
Compare (比) + compare (較): putting two things side by side, comparison.
Sad (悲) + drama (劇): a sad play, a tragedy.
Beautiful (美) + person (人): a beautiful person.
Pull (引) + cross over (越): pull your things over to a new home, moving house.
People (人) + packed in (込む): lots of people packed together, a crowd.
等 means equal, as in 平等 (equality): equal.
独 means alone, as in 独立: on your own, alone.
Criticise (批) + evaluate (評): judging the good and bad, a review.
Tiny (微) + subtle (妙): so fine it is hard to say, delicate.
広 means wide: make it wider, spread it out.
Wind (風) + view (景): the view you see as the wind blows, scenery.
Military (武) + tool (器): a fighting tool, a weapon.
Clothes (服) + dress up (装): how you are dressed, your attire.
Not (不) + happy (幸): unhappiness, misfortune.
Not (不) + freedom (自由): not free to do things easily, inconvenience or disability.
A husband's (夫) person (人): his wife, Mrs.
Not (不) + go through (通): nothing gets through, service stopped. (Not 普通, normal.)
Thing (物) + substance (質): what things are made of, matter.
Things (物) + logic (理): the logic of how things work, physics.
Not (不) + calm (平): not at peace, so you complain.
殖 means multiply, as in 繁殖 (breeding): make more, increase.
触 has a horn (角) and a bug (虫): a bug's feelers touching things, to touch.
Writing, culture (文) + bright (明): a bright, cultured society, civilization.
Brave (冒) + danger (険): braving danger, adventure.
Wrap (包) + dress up (装): wrapping things up nicely, packaging.
誇 has words (言): proud words about yourself, pride. (Same sound as ほこり, dust.)
貧 is divide (分) over money (貝): money split into tiny bits, poor.
混 has water (氵): stir things together in water, to mix.
招 has a hand (扌) and summon (召): wave your hand to call someone over, invite.
裁 means judge, as in 裁判 (trial): to judge a case.
Acid (酸, as in 酸素 oxygen) + change (化): changing by joining with oxygen, oxidation.
Resources (資) + status (格): what you have that gives you the right status, qualifications.
See (視) + sense (覚): the sense of seeing, vision.
Magnet (磁) + energy (気): magnetic force, magnetism.
Porcelain (磁) + vessel (器): china dishes and pots.
Letter (字) + body (体): the body shape of letters, a font.
Look (視) + point (点): the point you look from, point of view.
Fat (脂) + fat (肪): both have the flesh mark (月): body fat.
Aim (志) + hope (望): what you aim and hope for, ambition.
Improve (修) + decorate (飾): decorating; in grammar, a word that modifies another.
Private (私) + use (用): personal use, private business.
Do (仕) + way (様): the way to do it, method or specification.
Shine (照) + bright (明): lights that make it bright, illumination.
Woman (女) + scribe (史): a polite title for a learned woman, Ms.
Help (助) + word (詞): little helper words like は and を, particles.
Advance (進) + go (行): moving ahead, progress.
New (新) + rise (興): newly rising, emerging.
Shake (振) + rise (興): shaking things up so they rise, promotion.
Say humbly (申) + tell (告): reporting to officials, a statement like a tax return.
Water (水) + wash (洗): washing away with water, flushing, as in 水洗トイレ.
擦 has a hand (扌): rub with your hand, like striking a match (マッチを擦る).
Correct (正) + rule (規): by the proper rules, regular, legitimate.
Precise (精) + skilful (巧): finely and skilfully made, exquisite.
Precise (精) + calculate (算): calculating exactly, settling the fare.
Become (成) + age (年): reaching adult age.
Voice (声) + clear (明): saying something clearly out loud, a statement.
Surname (姓) + given name (名): your full name.
Life (生) + logic (理): how a living body works, physiology; also a period.
Ahead (先) + go (行): going first, preceding.
Choose (選) + think (考): thinking carefully to choose, screening.
添 means add on, as in 添付 (attach): to go along with someone.
Handle (操) + vertical (縦): moving the control stick up and down, piloting, control.
Withdraw (退) + school (学): leaving school, dropping out.
断 means cut off, as in 断る (refuse): to sever.
接 means connect, as in 接続: join pieces together, set bones.
Same (同) + aim (志): people with the same goal, comrades.
Move (動) + shake (揺): your heart moves and shakes, being upset.
Year (年) + mirror (鑑): a mirror of the whole year, a yearbook.
Wrong (非) + conduct (行): bad behaviour, delinquency.
Make up for (補) + repay (償): paying to make up for a loss, compensation.
Field (野) + party (党): the party out in the field, not in government.
Have (有) + working parts (機): like living things with working parts, organic.
氏 goes after surnames like Mr (田中氏): family name, lineage.
霜 has rain (雨) on top: frozen water on the ground at night, frost.
巣: three little chicks on top of a tree (木): a nest.
Woman (女) + born (生): the family you are born into, your surname.
脂 has the flesh mark (月) and tasty (旨): tasty fat on meat.
